name: Watara Supervision
description: A budget monochrome handheld released in 1992 by Hong Kong's Watara, sold worldwide under many brand names. It had a larger screen than the Game Boy and cheaper games, but a library of simple titles kept it from gaining ground. An official link let it play on a TV.

specs.sound: 2 tone + 1 noise channel, plus DMA audio

curiosities: It was sold as the QuickShot Supervision in the UK and the Hartung Supervision in Germany, among about ten other names.
Its hinged screen tilts to two viewing angles.
Its games cost about US$9 to $15, well below Game Boy prices.
Its first homebrew game, Assembloids, was released in 2020.
